decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 28 April 2005, the erection of a detached outbuilding to be used as a garage and store measuring 10m long, 7m wide and 4m high (maximum) was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposed outbuilding does not cover more than 50% of the total area of the curtilage (excluding the ground area of the original dwelling house).

Informative:
1		The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey building in rear end of garden for use as garage and store to house.
